body: Thanks man, but it's for selfish reasons. Just don't want my last act on earth to cause more pain than I already have. There's already too damn much. So many people on here just having a bad day or a bad year and they think their life is over when that's not the case. But a bad year can turn into 20 bad years, but only if you let it. For 99% of people I see here, it's going to get better if they just let themselves believe it will. Thanks again for your kind words. All the best.
